//: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check-copy.mjs. One entry per (string id, rule id) pair.

entries.reason: Line 4 of the seven lines says the reader CANNOT smell the benzene, which is what the rule requires; it does not name benzene as the smell.
Alt text from blueprint 4.10: 怠速 describes what the drawn scooters are doing. No idle emission figure is cited, and the same sentence says the layer's density has not been measured.
The caveat denies causation (「有關」，不是「造成」 / association, not cause): it is the rule's own point, and the word appears only to be ruled out.
Says 這不是零污染 / this is NOT zero pollution, then limits zero to this scooter's exhaust at the crossing, exactly as the rule asks (blueprint 3.11).
Zero is applied only to the scooter's own exhaust and the sentence states the crossing is not zero pollution (R8).

Label of the signal-cycle strip (blueprint V14, verbatim): 怠速 / Idling names the red phase as time spent standing beside the pack. No idle emission figure is given; the strip's own tag says scooters in Taiwan have not been measured.
Prologue deck (blueprint 3.1, verbatim): 怠速 / idles describes the scene the reader knows. It cites no measurement and the sentence goes on to ask what has and has not been measured.
